# Ghana CV Builder

> Free online CV and resume builder tailored for Ghanaian students, graduates, and professionals.

## Core Pages & Templates
- [Ghana CV Builder](https://ghanacv.cobbold.dev/): Online interactive builder with 10 ATS-friendly templates and instant PDF generation.
- [CV Templates Gallery](https://ghanacv.cobbold.dev/cv-templates): Modern, Classic, Compact, Executive, and Bold templates for Ghanaian job seekers.
- [CV Examples Directory](https://ghanacv.cobbold.dev/cv-examples): Real CV examples across IT, nursing, teaching, accounting, and sales in Ghana.
- [How to Write a CV Guide](https://ghanacv.cobbold.dev/how-to-write-a-cv): Comprehensive guide covering National Service Secretariat (NSS) experience, education, and referees.
- [Ghana CV Format Guide](https://ghanacv.cobbold.dev/cv-format): Recommended sections, layout standards, and length for applications in Ghana.
